pass_criteria.scope: Offline diagnostic bands chosen for this suite; not user acceptance or Unreal validation
pass_criteria.upper_crown_proxy_brightening_review_ban: flag if over20 percent and over2 code values brighter

interpretation: No frame is auto-framed or resized; distances are measured to declared targets at fixed 60-degree horizontal FOV.
5m pine and 2m bed/block views intentionally crop; separate hero previews show complete close assets.
Lit sRGB is measured from actual PNG bytes weighted by geometry alpha. Alpha excludes ground and cast shadows.
Small images are limited by pixel coverage; an individual plant may occupy fewer than one equivalent opaque pixel at distance. No mesh can guarantee screen visibility at every resolution or distance.
This is Blender CPU raster evidence only: Unreal Nanite, streaming, HLOD selection, materials and visibility were not tested.
4km pine LOD3 stress frames are additional limits evidence; not evidence of Unreal forest appearance.
